_note: Errata — corrections to what this site has said. Not a changelog: an entry earns its place only where a previous version was wrong, imprecise, or silent about something it should have stated. Backfilled from git history on 2026-08-19; every entry verified against its diff. Append by hand, newest first.

entries.note: Six workloads were listed with nothing said about the roster being deployment configuration, and the published client package was named nowhere on the site. Both stated.
Four figures stood without provenance, and the single-operator scope already carried in the source data was never rendered. Both corrected.
The copy announced a principle of one word and then gave a two-word phrase.

entries.note: The negative outcome-prediction result was not stated at all. Added, with its pre-registered kill criterion.
